games.name: 💥 BUCKSHOT
games.desc:
Loaded shotgun. Mixed shells. Your move.

Take turns with a shotgun loaded with lives and blanks. Shoot your rival, or risk a blank to keep the turn. Count every shell that's spent, play the odds, and lie to their face.

🔫 Duels and brawls
Tense 1v1 duels or 4-player tables where nobody trusts anybody.

🎒 Items
Peek shells, rack one out, handcuff rivals, heal, invert a shell, or steal what they were saving. Every item flips the round.

🏆 Ranked
Climb from placements to the top of the ladder. Seasonal ranks, exclusive titles, and a global top 100.

🎨 Skins and titles
Win cash, open cases, unbox skins from Common to Contraband and beyond. Rare drops roll a TrakStat module that counts your kills. Collect animated titles, level up, clear daily quests.

💱 Trading
Trade skins and titles with anyone, or hit the Trading Hub to hunt for limiteds. Some guns only exist in the double digits.

👍 Like the game and join our group for a free Deluxe Case + cash.
